product_metadata.title: GCIREC Pink Floral Shower Curtain, Pink and Grey Watercolor Rose Blossom Ink Painting Art Bathroom Curtain for Spring Bathtub Home Decor Waterproof Fabric Machine Washable with Hooks
features: [Premium Fabric] Our floral shower curtain is made of 100% polyester durable waterproof material, thick enough for privacy protection, good wrinkle resistance and shape retention, high strength and elastic recovery.

[Size & HD Printing] 3 Available size to choose.72x60 inches/72x72 inches/84x72 inches.72x72 inches size fit most bathtubs and shower stalls. Adopting the latest high-definition digital printing technology, clear patterns and bright colors, no odor, no fading,environmental protection.

[Multipurpose] Light up your bathroom, add fresh and cozy atmosphere to your bathroom and home, be applied in farm, hotel, door curtain, bathroom window curtain, room partition curtain, dorm room curtain, wardrobe curtain, car curtain for travel, camper-van curtain,etc.

[Install and Disassemble Quickly] There are rustproof metal grommets on the top, it comes with 12 pcs plastic hooks, and the stall shower curtain can be hung on the pole quickly by using curtain rings. It can be installed and removed easily.

[Easy to Care]Quick drying. It can be cleaned with a quick rinse or wipe after a shower. Machine-washable for easy care. If there is anything you dislike, please feel free to contact with us and we will give you a satisfactory solution.
